notes: Step numbers follow the printed step numbers 1-41; the step-26 sub-assembly (sub-steps 1-4) is counted as step 26.

Grid: x to the right across the 12-stud width, y towards the top of the face (16 studs, ears at high y), face-up display orientation. Layer 0 = the four boat-stud feet; the white base plates sit at layer 4 and the face is built on top (layers 5+). The back frame and stand hang underneath the base (layers 0-3).

Frame/stand and base: the frame is added after the face (flipped model, steps 22-29) and its studs clutch UP into the base's underside. In the final face-up positions the base plates therefore sit on top of the frame pieces and clutch them, so the base plates' rests_on lists the frame pieces (and p100 lists p101, p87 lists p98/p99, round bricks list their boat-plate feet) even though those pieces are added in later steps. This is a deliberate exception to 'earlier step only': the physical clutch really is base-bottom onto frame studs. The frame pieces themselves are also given in other_joins.
Smooth tiles (yellow 1x4/1x2/2x3, blue 2x4, white 1x4) have no studs; nothing rests on them; they are flush filler beside studded plates.
Wedged curved bricks p40/p42 are brick-height (3 plates), so p5 and p58 (step 41) are at layer 11 on top of them; p103 was shifted to (4,9) so it does not overlap p40.
Curved bricks p3/p4 and wedged curved bricks p39/p41 sit on the studs of the ear wedges p108/p107.
Exact positions in the face (cowl, eyes, jaw) are estimated from isometric booklet pictures and may be off by a stud in places.
The stand (elbow tubes p27/p28, red axle p66, long axles p6/p7, hinge cylinders p104/p105) is not on the stud grid, so position is null.
